name: Glassdoor

sources.title: Claim Your Free Employer Profile — Glassdoor employer signup

requirements: Must be an employer claiming a company profile — this is an employer-branding product, not a software/product directory
Free employer account gives access to the employer profile, review responses, review requests, and basic analytics
Enhanced Profile and employer branding features are paid upgrades
preparation: Work email and company details to claim the employer profile
Company logo, mission statement, and company-update content for profile customization
A real company with employees — profiles exist around employer reviews
workflow: Open glassdoor.com/employers/sign-up/ and sign up to claim the free employer profile
Verify company association (work email/domain verification typical for employer claims)
Complete the profile: logo, mission, company updates
Optionally request and respond to employee reviews
watchFor: Only appropriate for companies with actual employees/reviews — a shell product has nothing to claim
Batch eligibility claim confirmed: employer profile, not a product listing
Upsell pressure toward Enhanced Profile paid plans ('Getting started for free only scratches the surface')
Glassdoor requires claim verification; unverified claims don't go live
countsAsLive: The company's Glassdoor employer profile shows claimed status with populated branding fields
unknowns: Exact verification mechanism for claiming a profile
Whether the profile website link is followed
Free vs Enhanced feature boundary details on the pricing page
